## About This Project

**Project**: `absent-from-chronic` — Analysis of work absenteeism using the Canadian Community Health Survey (CCHS) PUMF microdata.

**Goal**: Understand how chronic health conditions relate to workplace absenteeism, using two pooled CCHS survey cycles (2010-2011 and 2013-2014).

**Data source**: CCHS PUMF (`.sav`) files stored in private data storage. These files are not committed to the repository. Contact the project lead to obtain them.

### Where to find the data

| Location | Contents |
|----------|----------|
| private data storage | Raw CCHS `.sav` files (CCHS2010_LOP.sav, CCHS_2014_EN_PUMF.sav) |
| private data storage | Ferry staging database (all raw columns) |
| private data storage | Parquet backup of raw tables |
| private data storage | Ellis analysis-ready Parquet files (`cchs_analytical.parquet`, `sample_flow.parquet`) |
| private data storage | Ellis SQLite output (same data, factors as character) |
| private data storage | Clarity-layer splits: `cchs_employed.parquet`, `cchs_unemployed.parquet`, `data_dictionary.parquet` |
| private data storage | SQLite version of Lane 3 outputs |

See the CACHE Manifest page in the Pipeline section for detailed descriptions.
